title: On the Complexity of Counting Orderings in Graphs
summary: We study the computational complexity of several counting problems on graphs. Each of these problems consists of counting orderings of the vertices or edges with adjacency constraints. We show $\#P$-completeness for all of them via a common new technique. Given a counting function $C$ of interest, we define a parameterized family of instances $G_q$, where the parameter $q$ controls the amplification of a simple gadget.
